_readme: EXAMPLE ONLY. The live file is docs/veri/sponsorlar.json: a plain JSON array of entries shaped like `example` below.
An empty array [] (the default) means no sponsor anywhere: every placement renders nothing.
An entry shows from `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive), ISO dates in UTC, and only on the `placements` it lists.
placements: discover | market-slide | market-launchpads | rail | more | trade | token (see #/advertise).
url and image must be https. title up to 40 characters, text up to 90; longer text is cut.
Every unit is labelled Sponsored. Nothing is counted or tracked: slots are flat-fee and time-based.
Several live entries on one placement take turns by the hour.

example.name: Example Launchpad
example.title: Launch on Example in one click
example.text: A short line about the product. No price promises, no guarantees.
